source: Kafka-compatible protocol, one trusted immutable topic/cluster, one reader session

supported.partitions: 1..4 explicitly fixed partition IDs 0..3, sorted unique absolute start offsets
supported.topic_contract: at most four partitions and four brokers; immutable incarnation and uncompressed <=32768-byte retained batches since topic creation
supported.security: explicit loopback development plaintext or certificate/hostname-verified SASL_SSL PLAIN using bounded environment credentials
supported.event: strict JSON EventV1: version=1, key:u64, value_i64:i64, event_time_ms:i64; payload <=4096 bytes
supported.native: shared ade-exec UInt64 key less-than filter, Arrow value/key/time projection, explicit filtered receipts
supported.offsets: increasing legal holes, distinct seen and sink-forwarded cursors, nondurable explicit restart suggestions
supported.progress: checked monotone max-forwarded-time minus allowance per partition; global min/unknown, idle never completes
supported.timers: bounded in-process monotonic processing/event timers; inclusive deadlines, deterministic ties, no per-session refiring
supported.sink: nonblocking Unix NDJSON file/pipe receipts; whole-frame write acknowledgment, finite stall deadline
supported.backpressure: one in-flight record; no downstream channel; stop partition polling while sink blocked; bounded native prefetch; control/statistics continue
supported.stop: SIGINT cancellation, failure or explicit finite operator test limit; discard unacknowledged input; no source EOF

refused_or_deferred: Compressed or mutable historical topics; implicit offset reset or malformed-message skipping
Non-loopback plaintext, insecure TLS and arbitrary client property overrides
Automatic retry/replay, crash recovery, durable offsets or source incarnation/leader-epoch attestation
Transactional sinks, fsync/publication, external consumer acknowledgment or end-to-end exactly-once
Windows, aggregates, joins, keyed state, checkpoint barriers, savepoints, durable timers
General SQL/unbounded PlanV1, optimizer integration, nested/cyclic frontiers
Multi-worker streaming, physical elasticity, HA, cloud/cross-host production deployment, more connectors
